coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 5 ground-truth variable items: alphabetical sorting, string and word-list inputs, the split–sorted()–space-join sequence, and a single-line space-separated sorted output. Mode B is not specified.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The fixed mode B is omitted. The design also adds NFC normalization and case-insensitive casefold sorting, which are not specified in the ground truth and can change the ordering relative to ordinary sorted().
